item.title: Full-length direct RNA sequencing uncovers stress-granule dependent RNA decay upon cellular stress
item.description: Full-length direct RNA sequencing reveals that stress granules are hubs for selective mRNA decay during cellular stress, linking stress granule biology to RNA homeostasis.

item.title: Deep learning and direct sequencing of labeled RNA captures transcriptome dynamics
item.description: RNAkinet is a neural network that identifies newly synthesized 5EU-labeled RNA from nanopore direct RNA sequencing signals, enabling simultaneous profiling of RNA metabolism and regulatory elements at single-molecule resolution.

item.title: Long-Read Direct RNA Sequencing Technologies
item.description: We develop experimental and computational technologies based on nanopore direct RNA sequencing to capture the native state of RNA in cells at single-molecule resolution.
